name: usitc-tariffs-mcp-server
description: Search USITC tariff schedules, inspect heading trees, and look up published duty rates via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search USITC tariff schedules, inspect heading trees, and look up published duty rates via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Find U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule codes from product descriptions, inspect the indented classification hierarchy, and read the published General, Special, and Column 2 duty rates. Resolve Special Program Indicators by country of origin and inspect Chapter 99 candidate headings with their source notes. Results describe the published schedule; they do not determine current legal applicability or calculate a combined duty.
